title: Using AI tools responsibly
examples: Can I use AI to write my whole essay?
How do I make sure the AI isn't making things up?
Is using AI for brainstorming okay?

explain.say: Today we learn to use AI tools safely and fairly.
First, you must always check the facts the AI gives you.

draw.text: Check the facts given by AI

explain.say: For example, if the AI says the capital is wrong, you must find the real one.
Next, we talk about academic honesty when using these tools.
This means you must always give credit for AI help you receive.
In real life, you should use AI to help you plan, not to finish the job.

faq.q: Can I use AI to write my whole essay for me?
faq.a: No, you should not submit work entirely written by AI. You must write your own thoughts and ideas.
asks: Is it cheating to let AI write my paper?
Can AI do my assignment for me?

faq.q: If the AI gives me a date, how do I know it is correct?
faq.a: You must check that date using a reliable textbook or trusted website. Do not trust the AI blindly.

faq.q: Does giving credit to AI count as cheating?
faq.a: No, giving credit is the opposite of cheating. It shows you are being honest about your sources.
asks: Do I need to mention AI in my bibliography?

faq.q: What if I use AI just for brainstorming ideas?
faq.a: Using it for brainstorming is usually fine, but you must still develop and write the final ideas yourself.
asks: Can I use AI for ideas only?

faq.q: Are there times when using AI is completely banned?
faq.a: Yes, submitting AI work as your own original thought is generally considered academic misconduct.
asks: What is the rule on AI submissions?

facts: AI tools are powerful aids, but they are not always accurate.
Academic honesty means giving credit for all sources, including AI.
Always verify facts from AI using reliable, trusted sources.
AI is best used for brainstorming and drafting, not final submission.

quiz.say: If an AI tells you a historical date, what is the very first thing you should do?
quiz.why: You must confirm facts from other reliable sources.

wrong.0: Ignoring it means you lose important information.
wrong.1: You are still not checking against a trusted source.
wrong.3: This is dangerous because AI can make up facts.

quiz.say: Which action shows the best academic honesty when using AI?

options.show: Only citing the website where you found the AI.
options.say: Only citing the website where you found the AI.

options.show: Mentioning the AI tool in your bibliography.
options.say: Mentioning the AI tool in your bibliography.

options.show: Just using the ideas without mentioning it.
options.say: Just using the ideas without mentioning it.

options.show: Editing the text heavily and forgetting to cite.
options.say: Editing the text heavily and forgetting to cite.

quiz.why: Giving credit shows you are honest about your sources.

wrong.0: You must cite the specific tool used, not just the webpage.
wrong.2: This is plagiarism because you hide the source.
wrong.3: Even edited text needs source acknowledgment.
